stories.title: Navi Mumbai Crime News 6 Arrested For Posing As FDA Officials, Extorting ₹2.66 Lakh From Vashi Trader After Fake Gutkha Raid
stories.summary: NaveShahar Navi Mumbai: The APMC police have arrested six persons for allegedly posing as Food and Drug Administration (FDA) officials and extorting money from pan shop owners and grocery traders by threatening them with raids and legal action over the sale of gutkha.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA crackdown: Licences of Miyan Kababs, Natural Ice Cream suspended
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licences of 12 food establishments, including nine prominent restaurants in South Mumbai such as Chetana, Cafe Ideal, Bayroute, Miyan Kababs and Natural Ice Cream, following inspections that allegedly found serious food safety and hygiene violations. 27 crore across Maharashtra, shut down the businesses of six food vendors at Pune's Manikbaug Khau Galli and arrested five people during a statewide crackdown.

stories.title: Subordinate court staff go on indefinite strike over pay parity
stories.summary: Around 34,000 subordinate court employees across Maharashtra began an indefinite strike on Tuesday, demanding a revised pay scale on par with Bombay High Court staff. The strike disrupted work in courts across Mumbai, with hundreds of employees gathering outside the Sessions Court in Fort. The agitation has been called by four major associations representing subordinate court employees.

stories.title: Mumbai: Newborns at BMC hospitals to get birth certificates within three days
stories.summary: Newborns delivered at Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)-run hospitals will now receive their birth certificates within three days of registration, bringing relief to parents who earlier had to visit civic administrative offices to complete the process. BMC officials on Tuesday, November 17, announced that the birth certificates would be issued directly at the hospitals where the children are born.

stories.title: Pedestrian First Campaign: BMC Demolishes 27 Structures in Kandivali West to End 15-Year Road-Widening Delay
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has demolished 27 commercial structures at the Mathuradas Road–Swami Vivekanand Road (SV Road) junction in Kandivali West, clearing a major hurdle in a road-widening project that had remained stalled for nearly 15 years.

stories.title: Mumbai's Dadar station to be renamed Chaityabhoomi, says CM Fadnavis
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government will complete the necessary legislative process during the upcoming Assembly session to rename Dadar railway station as Chaityabhoomi, Chief Minister (CM) Devendra Fadnavis said on Wednesday. The state government has already given in-principle approval to the proposal and sent a letter to the Centre.

stories.title: Mumbai’s First Underground Toilet-Cum-Art Gallery Planned at Kala Ghoda; BMC Approves ₹24-Crore Project
stories.summary: In a move to improve pedestrian movement and preserve the heritage character of South Mumbai, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) has given in-principle approval to develop an underground public facility near Lion Gate in Kala Ghoda. Estimated to cost ₹24 crore, the proposed project will replace the existing Aspirational Toilet and Solid Waste Management (SWM) department chowkies with a 1,668-square-metre underground complex.

stories.title: Mumbai car dealer's trade certificate suspended over Ferrari delivery
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Transport Department has suspended the trade certificate of a Mumbai-based car dealer for 30 days for allegedly handing over a Ferrari to a customer before completing the vehicle’s registration, officials said on Wednesday. According to the Transport Commissioner’s office, a Navnit Motors outlet in Bandra delivered a red Ferrari to its owner on October 13, before completing its registration formalities, in violation of prescribed rules.

stories.title: Mumbai: Shiv Sena (UBT) Protests Outside Mayor's Office After Shaina NC Accidentally Tears Balasaheb Thackeray's Photo At Press Meet | VIDEO
stories.summary: VIDEO | X Mumbai: Shiv Sena (UBT) corporators and party workers on Wednesday staged a protest outside Mumbai Mayor Ritu Tawde's office after Shaina NC, a leader of the Shiv Sena group led by Eknath Shinde, was seen accidentally tearing a photograph of party founder Balasaheb Thackeray during a press conference.

stories.title: Kate Middleton debuts late Queen Elizabeth's sparkling emerald-diamond necklace for Earthshot Prize with Prince William in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, Prince William and Kate Middleton, attended the sixth annual Earthshot Prize awards ceremony in Mumbai. The royal couple is in India to attend the Earthshot Prize events and meet young environmental innovators from across the world. For the awards ceremony in Mumbai, Prince William traded the tuxedo for a black Manish Malhotra bandhgala.

stories.title: 53 year old man stabbed in local train, accused arrested
stories.summary: An elderly passenger was allegedly stabbed inside a Virar-Churchgate fast local, leaving him injured near Andheri railway station. The incident took place on November 15, when train was heading to Churchgate, near Andheri station, the accused threw knife on fellow passenger, identified as Suresh Sharma (53), a resident of Dharavi’s Sion area.

stories.title: 'I Felt So Emotional': Karan Johar On Showing K3G Clips To Prince William At His Mumbai Office, Recalls Kareena Kapoor's Reaction - VIDEO
stories.summary: Filmmaker Karan Johar recently experienced a special moment when he introduced Prince William to the world of Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham (K3G) during the royal's visit to his Dharma Productions office in Mumbai on Wednesday (November 18). The filmmaker revealed that he became emotional while showing the British royal clippings from the iconic film, which is set to complete 25 years this December.

stories.title: Duo promising Navi Mumbai airport jobs for cash arrested
stories.summary: 63 lakh fraud, with a Nalasopara woman and her relatives claiming they were cheated by two men who promised them private-sector employment but failed to provide jobs despite collecting money. The 27-year-old woman approached Vakola police station after repeatedly failing to get a response from the accused — Sudhakar Fatarpekar and his nephew Sai Sanjay Fatarpekar.

stories.title: BEST Bus Catches Fire Near Sassoon Dock After Sparks Emerge From Starter; Vehicle Badly Damaged, Passenger Escapes Unhurt
stories.summary: Mumbai: A fire broke out in a BEST bus near Sassoon Dock on Tuesday morning after sparks were noticed near its starter, leaving the vehicle extensively damaged. The incident occurred around 7 am when the bus was operating on Route 139 from Colaba Depot towards Gita Nagar.

stories.title: Bombay High Court questions BMC’s ‘temporary show’ of cleaning up city for royal guests ‘at lightning speed’, says do the same for citizens
stories.summary: “We just observe, when some guests were coming, see Ballard Estate now, how shining and polished it is. If you want to do it, you do it, including painting, cleaning the streets with water... “If the state govt and the BMC have a will to do, they can transform things in no time.

stories.title: ‘Clean Mumbai for Citizens’: Bombay HC Raps BMC Over VIP-Focused Cleanliness Drive, Demands Permanent Solution
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court (HC) on Wednesday, November 18, criticised the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation ( BMC ) and the Maharashtra government for failing to maintain cleanliness across Mumbai , questioning why the city was spruced up only ahead of high-profile visits.

stories.title: Mumbai: Prince William takes electric rickshaw for a spin at Bandra reclamation
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales, William and Catherine, drove an electric autorickshaw on the promenade at Bandra Reclamation Garden on Tuesday morning. The appearance was to meet the finalists of the Earthshot Prize at the waterfront. Tuesday marked the second day of their ongoing three-day visit to Mumbai.

stories.title: ₹15.53 Crore Residential Deal Sets New Benchmark In Vile Parle West
stories.summary: 53 crore, marking the highest-value residential deal in the micro-market and setting a new benchmark for luxury real estate in the neighbourhood, particularly for luxury flats in Vile Parle West. stories.title: Mumbai: Five bikers arrested for performing dangerous stunts on WEH
stories.summary: Mumbai Police have arrested five bikers for allegedly performing dangerous stunts, driving recklessly and creating a public nuisance on the Western Express Highway (WEH) . As per the officials, the action was taken after a video highlighting the bikers' activities circulated on social media, prompting the police to take cognisance of the incident.

stories.title: Dawood Ibrahims Ancestral Home In Mumbais Bhendi Bazaar To Be Demolished By BMC | Video
stories.summary: Mumbai: A building in south Mumbai’s Bhendi Bazaar, identified as the ancestral home of fugitive underworld figure Dawood Ibrahim, was partially demolished by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) on Wednesday. Visuals from the site showed the structure being pulled down, with debris scattered across the premises as residents gathered to witness the demolition.

stories.title: BMC signs MoU with Dutch non-profit to tackle plastic pollution in Mumbai rivers
stories.summary: In a move to tackle plastic pollution in Mumbai's waterways, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Netherlands-based non-profit organisation The Ocean Cleanup to expand waste interception operations across the city. The agreement signed between The Ocean Cleanup and the BMC will also facilitate nine additional permits for deploying the organisation's Interceptor systems in Mumbai's waterways.

stories.title: SpiceJet passengers left stranded at Mumbai airport over severe flight delays, lack of clarity; triggers protests
stories.summary: Chaos erupted at the Mumbai airport on Tuesday evening as several SpiceJet flights faced severe delays, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded for hours. Travellers, some of whom had been waiting since 7 PM, gathered at the airline's counters to protest the lack of communication about their revised departure schedules.

stories.title: Shivaji Maharaj’s Historic Vagh Nakh Goes on Display at Mumbai Museum
stories.summary: Mumbaikars can now witness the historic Vagh Nakh (tiger claw weapon) associated with Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and his legendary encounter with Afzal Khan in 1659. The centuries-old weapon has gone on public display at the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (CSMVS) in South Mumbai as part of a special exhibition titled ‘Shivshastra Shauryagatha’.

stories.title: Mumbai: Man arrested for demanding Rs 1 lakh from Nanded businessman
stories.summary: Police in Maharashtra's Nanded have arrested a man in Mumbai for allegedly demanding Rs 1 lakh from a businessman. Officials said that the accused threatened the victim with a claim that he had previously plotted to kill a former Maharashtra Chief Minister and four MLAs from the district, as per PTI.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai Airport Job Scam: Fraudsters Allegedly Cheat Job Seekers Of Over ₹23 Lakh With Fake Employment Promises
stories.summary: A family has allegedly been cheated of more than ₹23 lakh by two men who promised to secure well-paying jobs at the Navi Mumbai International Airport. Vakola Police have registered a cheating case against two accused, identified as Sudhakar Fatarpekar and Sai Fatarpekar.

stories.title: 24-Hour Water Cut In Kalyan-Dombivli And Ulhasnagar On November 19 As MIDC Announces Maintenance Shutdown
stories.summary: Residents of Kalyan-Dombivli and Ulhasnagar will have to brace for another spell of water scarcity as the Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) has announced a 24-hour water supply shutdown from midnight on November 19 to midnight on November 20. The disruption is being undertaken to carry out maintenance and repair work at MIDC's Barvi Water Treatment Plant.

stories.title: Gandhinagar-Mumbai Vande Bharat Express Targeted In 'Stone-Pelting' Incident Near Surat; C4 Coach Window Damaged | VIDEO
stories.summary: The Gandhinagar-Mumbai Vande Bharat Express was reportedly targeted in a reported stone-pelting incident near Sachin railway station in Gujarat, . The incident led to damage to the outer glass of a window in the train's C4 coach. The incident which occurred on Tuesday evening, November 17,took place near Sachin railway station, between Surat and Navsari.

stories.title: Man arrested for allegedly killing acquaintance over unpaid mobile loan
stories.summary: A man allegedly killed his 23-year-old acquaintance following a dispute over unpaid mobile loan instalments and dumped the body in bushes at a village in Navi Mumbai, police said on Wednesday. Officials said that the incident occurred last week. They also added that the accused, identified as Pratik Mohan Jadhav (30), a resident of Panvel in Navi Mumbai, was arrested on Monday, as per PTI.

stories.title: Rajkumar Wankhede takes charge as Additional General Manager of Central Railway
stories.summary: Rajkumar Wankhede has taken charge as the Additional General Manager of Central Railway , bringing more than 36 years of experience in railway infrastructure, construction and project management. Wankhede is an officer of the 1990 batch of the Indian Railway Service of Engineers (IRSE). Before his appointment to Central Railway, he was serving as Additional General Manager of North Central Railway.

stories.title: Man hit by knife thrown during fight on local train
stories.summary: A 53-year-old man was injured after a knife thrown during a fight between two passengers on a local train struck him in the chest on Sunday, the latest among several violent incidents this year that have drawn attention to commuter safety on the suburban rail network

stories.title: LeT’s ‘last local recruit’ Lateef Bhat killed outside a Kulgam mosque
stories.summary: Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Lateef Bhat, whom top police officials described as “the last local recruit” in Kashmir, was killed outside a Kulgam mosque that he had been using for shelter on Wednesday. Security forces found Bhat, 22, after an eight-day operation led them to a mosque in Kulgam’s Zangalpora.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan intensifies into severe storm, likely to make landfall by November 20

stories.title: Shiv Sena tears pages of Sonia Gandhi’s memoir over Savarkar remarks, Congress hits back
stories.summary: The Shiv Sena on Wednesday alleged that Congress leader Sonia Gandhi’s memoir “Belonging – A journey of love” was “filled with poison” against Hindutva ideologue V D Savarkar and demanded a ban on the distribution of the book. At a press conference in Mumbai, party leaders and members, including national spokesperson Sanjay Nirupam, also tore pages from the book as a symbolic protest.

stories.title: GRAP III Curbs Revoked In Delhi-NCR As Air Quality Improves
stories.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) on Tuesday lifted Stage III restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) across Delhi-NCR, citing a sustained improvement in air quality over the past three days. Delhi recorded a daily average Air Quality Index (AQI) of 204 on Tuesday, prompting the pollution watchdog to withdraw the additional curbs.

stories.title: Azam Khan Walks Out Of Jail After Getting Bail In Money Laundering Case
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Azam Khan was released from Dasna district jail in Ghaziabad on interim bail on Wednesday. Khan’s son, Abdullah Azam Khan, arrived at the jail premises to welcome his father. The court directed Khan’s release on a personal bond along with two sureties of an equal amount.

stories.title: NASA's Voyager 1 space probe is now one light-day away from Earth
stories.summary: It traveled more than 49 years to get to this point, and its journey isn’t done yet. NASA Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover If NASA's estimates are correct, Voyager 1 is already one light-day away from our planet. NASA expects it to have reached that milestone at 5:16:07 AM Eastern time today, November 18.

stories.title: Need to ascertain if ‘reel makers’ can be called journalists: Delhi Police to Supreme Court
stories.summary: The Delhi police have told the Supreme Court that in the evolving digital media era, there is a need to ascertain if “reel makers” and “content creators” can be elevated to the status of journalists.

stories.title: NEET Paper Leak Case: Delhi Court Orders Framing Of Charges Against 14 Accused, Trial To Begin November 25
stories.summary: Special Judge Ajay Gupta directed that all 14 accused be produced before the court on November 21 for the formal framing of charges. A detailed order from the court is awaited. The court ordered the framing of charges for criminal conspiracy, cheating, criminal breach of trust and destruction of evidence.

stories.title: Maharashtra declares four more talukas drought-hit; total count rises to 308
stories.summary: The Maharashtra government has declared four more talukas drought-hit following deficient rainfall, taking the total number of affected talukas to 308 out of the state's 358. The decision was taken on Tuesday at a meeting of the state cabinet's drought relief sub-committee at Mantralaya, chaired by Revenue Minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule.

stories.title: Mission Mirchi's Sikkim shoot marred by tragedy, technician dies in road accident
stories.summary: The shoot of Maddock Films ' upcoming film, Mission Mirchi, was hit by tragedy on Tuesday after a technician working on the production died in a road accident. The film is being shot in Sikkim . Local police said that the 46-year-old technician died after a truck carrying shooting equipment met with an accident.

stories.title: After a 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI arrives with enormous hype and expectations
stories.summary: LOS ANGELES (AP) — After a 13-year wait, one of entertainment’s biggest releases is finally here. “Grand Theft Auto VI” launches Thursday, sending players back to Vice City and testing whether Rockstar Games can follow one of the bestselling video games ever made with another cultural and commercial phenomenon.

stories.title: Abhishek made tea on sets when Amitabh Bachchan faced bankruptcy
stories.summary: Amitabh Bachchan may be one of the most successful superstars in the Indian film industry today, but his journey has not been without financial setbacks. One of the most difficult phases of his life came in the late 1990s, when his entertainment venture, Amitabh Bachchan Corporation Limited (ABCL), ran into severe financial trouble and reportedly left him with debts of Rs 90 crore.

stories.title: Maharashtra judicial employees’ federations suspend indefinite strike; Sheena Bora case, several other sessions court matters adjourned
stories.summary: The federations said they suspended the strike “honouring the request made by Hon’ble Judges” and “respecting the status and prestige of the Hon’ble Judges and the assurance expressed by them.” At the same time, the federations cautioned that the suspension is temporary. The letter states that if Maharashtra govt takes no satisfactory decision or concrete action in the Nov 26 meeting, the federations and associated organisations will decide on further agitation.

stories.title: Two burglars arrested in Raichur, gold, silver ornaments worth ₹45.95 lakh seized
stories.summary: 95 lakh from them on Tuesday. According to a press release issued by Superintendent of Police Arunangshu Giri on Tuesday, the accused have been identified as Amar Singh and Dhanaraj Singh, both native of Raichur city. The police recovered 300 grams of gold ornaments and 500 grams of silver articles from their possession, besides seizing a motorcycle used in the commission of the offences.

stories.title: ABVP, SFI clash over bookstall in Kolkata’s College Street
stories.summary: Members of the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) and the Students’ Federation of India (SFI) on Wednesday clashed over bookstall in Kolkata’s College Street. Stones, firecrackers, eggs and water bottles were hurled during the standoff; however, police said no one sustained any critical injury, and no arrests were made until 7 pm.

stories.title: Salman Khan’s Maatrubhumi gets CBFC clearance after months of delays, gets UA 16 rating
stories.summary: As per the certification details, Maatrubhumi ‘s runtime is of 2 hours, 34 minutes and 12 seconds. The Salman Khan-film has been certified under the Hindi language category, with Salman Khan Ventures Private Limited listed as both its producer and applicant. The CBFC has described Maatrubhumi as an epic of courage being fought on two fronts.

stories.title: IPL trades hit record high: The strategy behind the Rs. 100 crore-plus player shuffle
stories.summary: The curtain had barely come down on the IPL 2026 season when a media advisory arrived on June 23, signalling the start of the next season’s news cycle. The circular carried news of a trade between Delhi Capitals and Lucknow Super Giants, which would see LSG skipper Rishabh Pant return to his home team DC, with wrist-spinner Kuldeep Yadav moving in the opposite direction.

stories.title: Gurugram: 2 arrested in PayU's cloud servers breach, siphoning over ₹25 crore
stories.summary: Gurugram cyber police have arrested two accused in an alleged fraud case involving a breach of a private payments service provider's cloud servers, resulting in a loss of more than ₹ 25 crore, officials said on Wednesday. The accused allegedly provided bank accounts to cybercriminals, who were arrested in Punjab's Ludhiana, they said.

stories.title: Pearl Harbor survivor Gebhard Galle, who rescued 4 sailors from sinking ship, dies at 105
stories.summary: Galle died on Saturday at his home in Moses Lake, Washington, the Pacific Historic Parks said. His death came on the same day as that of Freeman Johnson, 106, believed to be the oldest surviving veteran of the December 7, 1941, attack. stories.title: Youth killed, friend injured as lorry hits motorcycle at PM Palem
stories.summary: An 18-year-old teen was killed and his friend sustained serious injuries after a lorry rammed into their motorcycle at PM Palem in the early hours of Wednesday. The deceased was identified as G. Ruthik (18), while the injured person was identified as G. Sai (19). According to the police, a lorry proceeding towards Maddilapalem allegedly hit the motorcycle due to the driver’s rash and negligent driving.

stories.title: India news: Modi proposes e-visas for ASEAN tourists
stories.summary: 11/17/2026 November 17, 2026 Dhoni retires from IPL, becomes CSK mentor Former Chennai Super Kings (CSK) captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni retired from the Indian Premier League (IPL) — a professional Twenty20 (T20) cricket league in India — ahead of the 2027 season. stories.title: Maharashtra Deputy CM Eknath Shinde Backs Shaina NC In Row Over Balasaheb Thackeray Picture, Says Torn Part Was Mani Shankar Aiyar Face | Videos
stories.summary: Videos | ANI Mumbai (Maharashtra): Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde on Wednesday accused Congress leader Sonia Gandhi's memoir of insulting Veer Savarkar as he defended party spokesperson Shaina NC in the row over allegations that she tore a photograph of Balasaheb Thackeray.

stories.title: ‘Heavens Won’t Fall’: Supreme Court Refuses To Stay Azam Khan’s Interim Bail, To Hear ED’s Plea On Thursday
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday refused to stay the interim bail granted to senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan in a money laundering case. The court said there was no need for immediate intervention and allowed Khan to remain on interim bail.

stories.title: Upasana Singh Recalls Crew Deaths On Set, Says Shoots Continued Uninterrupted
stories.summary: Actor Upasana Singh has questioned the lack of humanity in the entertainment industry during a recent conversation with Ankur Singh on his YouTube channel. Recalling a disturbing incident from her time as a judge on a comedy reality show, she spoke about how the race for TRPs can sometimes take precedence over people's well-being.

stories.title: GST Reforms 2026 CBIC Announces 'Trust First, Verify Later' Approach, Faster Refunds, ₹5 Crore Prosecution Threshold & MSME Relief
stories.summary: cbic_india New Delhi, Nov 18: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime is moving towards a ‘Trust First, Verify Later’ framework that places compliant taxpayers at the centre of tax administration, CBIC Chairman Vivek Chaturvedi said on Wednesday and outlined a series of reforms to simplify compliance and reduce enforcement-related friction.

stories.title: Delhi Court Seeks Police Report On Complaint Against Sonia Gandhi Over Alleged Irregularities In 1980 Voter Roll Entry
stories.summary: File A Delhi court on Wednesday sought an action taken report (ATR) from Delhi Police on a complaint alleging that Congress leader Sonia Gandhi’s name was included in the electoral roll in 1980, nearly three years before she acquired Indian citizenship.

stories.title: Sonakshi Sinha mocks outrage over Rahul Gandhi’s ‘mom on papa’s lap’ remark: ‘Uncs losing it’
stories.summary: The Rowdy Rathore actor cheekily wrote, “Dammmmn my future kids have no idea whats comin their way. Buckle up kiddos (wherever you’ll are right now) (sic)” with several laughing emojis. Sonakshi’s reaction also comes from someone who has never shied away from expressing affection for her husband, actor Zaheer Iqbal .

stories.title: SC issues notice to CJP, Congress, AAP, AISA on traders’ plea against Delhi protests
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Wednesday sought responses from political parties, including the Congress and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), and organisations such as the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and the All India Students Union (AISA), on a petition by market traders’ associations challenging the designation of Ramlila Maidan as a protest venue.

stories.title: Shelly’s new smart valve shuts off your home’s water before a leak becomes a flood
stories.summary: After releasing a $28 leak sensor earlier this year that conveniently runs off a battery for two years, Shelly is announcing an accompanying smart valve you can install on your home's main water line to automatically turn off the flow when one of those sensors detects a problem.

stories.title: Bhima Koregaon Case: Bombay HC Disposes Of Father Stan Swamy's Bail Petition Five Years After His Death In Custody
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday disposed of a petition filed by Father Stan Swamy, an accused in the Bhima Koregaon-Elgar Parishad case, challenging a special court’s order rejecting his bail plea. The court noted that the matter had become infructuous following his death in judicial custody in July 2021.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan Changes Track, Bengal On Alert As Heavy Rain Expected From Thursday
stories.summary: Cyclone ‘Akvan’ over the Bay of Bengal has changed its course, with the weather department now predicting that it could make landfall between Narsapur in Andhra Pradesh and Puri in Odisha. The cyclone is expected to bring heavy to extremely heavy rainfall to West Bengal between November 19 and 21.

stories.title: Why Ukraine keeps targeting the Kerch Bridge
stories.summary: In 2022, Ukraine bombed the Kerch bridge linking mainland Russia to the Crimean Peninsula, using explosives hidden in a truck. In 2023, naval drones struck the bridge. In 2025, covert Ukrainian operatives planted bombs on its undersea support pillars. But none of these attacks caused major damage to the structure, which Russian President Vladimir Putin described in 2018 as a “miracle”.

stories.title: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be US Speaker of the House
stories.summary: Democrats in the US House of Representatives officially nominated Hakeem Jeffries to be Speaker, setting him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber. The House will elect its new Speaker on 3 January, when the next term begins and Democrats will hold a majority of the seats.

stories.summary: 40 crore contract with Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) for the upgradation and obsolescence management of the Barak point defence missile system deployed on board Indian Navy warships. stories.summary: A Pakistani man with ties to Iran's government has been sentenced to 27 years in prison for his role in a plot to assassinate US President Donald Trump and other officials.

stories.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
stories.summary: Kuwait and Bahrain have said they repelled Iranian air attacks overnight as hostilities between Iran and the United States rise. The drone attack on Kuwait was the first in more than two months.
